sources.title: Brusatte etal2009 A long-snouted multihorned tyrannosaurid from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia
sources.supports: Actually inspected original Fig1 fossil skull elements and Fig3 partial skeleton reconstruction. Long shallow snout, three nasal rugosities, lateral jugal horns, nine-year-old juvenile and missing regions documented.
